Defunct: fit curves with the old fitting path

Source: R/fit_curves.R
fit_curves-defunct.Rd

fit_curves() and logisticFit() were a second copy of the gDR Hill fit with hard-coded priors. Every fit now goes through fit_drug_response_metrics, whose priors and bounds come from inst/extdata/fit_profiles.json and whose optimiser is a parameter (solver_drc by default).

Usage

fit_curves(...)

logisticFit(...)

Arguments

...

ignored.

Value

Does not return; stops with a message pointing to fit_drug_response_metrics().
